service_area.outside_area_policy: Take their details anyway and tell them the owner will call back to confirm whether we can cover their location.

hours.emergency: 24/7 for trees on houses, cars, or blocking driveways and roads

services.name: Tree removal
services.notes: Any size. Includes cleanup and haul-away unless the customer wants to keep the wood.

services.name: Tree trimming and pruning
services.notes: Deadwood removal, shaping, clearing branches off roofs.

services.name: Stump grinding
services.notes: Can be added to a removal or booked on its own.

services.name: Lot and land clearing
services.notes: Larger jobs; always needs a site visit.

services.name: Firewood
services.notes: Seasoned firewood for sale, delivered locally.

not_offered: Work directly on or touching power lines (that is the utility company's job)

pricing.policy: Every job is quoted after seeing the tree (photos or a free on-site estimate). Only give the rough ranges below, always say the final price depends on the tree, and never promise an exact price.

ranges.trimming: usually $250 to $1,000 depending on size and number of trees

faq.q: Do I need to be home for the estimate?
faq.a: Not necessarily, as long as the crew can get to the tree. We'll text when we're on the way.

faq.q: How soon can you do the job?
faq.a: Estimates are usually within 1 to 3 days. The work itself is typically scheduled within 1 to 2 weeks, faster for urgent jobs.

lead_routing.emergencies: Notify the owner immediately by call and text, any hour.
